title: GoldHoldingsPanel
description: Schema for sovereign and institutional central bank gold holdings panel data.

entity.description: ISO country code or institutional identifier (US, EA, CN, JP, CH, IMF, AGGREGATE).

date.description: Entity observation end date (YYYY-MM-DD), or YYYY-MM for the AGGREGATE execution-month summary.

tonnes.description: Physical gold holdings measured in metric tonnes.

status.description: Data freshness status or summary status flag.
